current_single_dual.scope: Engineering comparison using three clean hot requests per mode. Single GPU0 spans two sessions, with a full warmup in each, because external GPU0 entry interrupted the original third request. Dual GPU0+2 is one session with one warmup. No contaminated half-request is included. Not an isolated hardware scaling result or a best-tuned single-GPU engine.
